The finite parity classes have the correct size, and period minimality follows from the same identity and the length-seven parity word; the proof holds for every exponent, without extrapolation. The embedded checker executes direct finite tests.

value.rationale: A standard cubic counting recurrence has a nonuniform and complicated full modular residue distribution. The theorem supplies two explicit, natural arithmetic index rays representing every residue exactly once at every power-of-two precision, and establishes canonical two-adic inverse selectors plus the sharp uniqueness criterion among all 7 base progressions. This is a genuine modular fiber result with use for congruence inversion and local distribution, not an arbitrary isolated congruence or a mere restatement of the known period.
